firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: tool-first carton board, phone in header, Sample proof line; h1 names neither trade nor city (eyebrow only, -0.5); 'Book this list' three times in one view (-0.5); next band peeks ~25px. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, Call + Book above fold, bottom bar.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: carton/stencil system in hero tiles, PC plates, wall checker, haul-away band, checklist codes, reviews, footer bundle; siblings A/C 1440-first.jpg share nothing. Ghost PC 0X outlines decorative in every section (1440-scroll-50.jpg, -0.5); #pieces ledger reads as bento (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Sofia Sans Condensed + Geist + mono accent carry the concept; 4+ tiny tracked mono caps labels in one view (-0.5). 390-first.jpg: mono eyebrow splits 'JERSEY / CITY, NJ'.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: tones alternate cleanly, 4+ layout families, sticky margin column. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: dead paper after the 1 YR line; only one full-bleed break and no quiet statement section, so the scroll has no visible shape.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: no photograph or video anywhere (dist has 0 img, 0 video). Wall cross-section SVGs are on-topic and consistent, but the homeowner never sees a mounted TV, a built bed or cartons in a hallway.

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg: specific trade nouns (sleeve anchors, freight elevator, COI), every figure Sample-tagged, 0 em dashes. Primary action has four names: Book this list / Price it / Add to my booking / Send the list (1440-full.jpg, -0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: re-composed hero, split bottom bar 'Call | PC 00 My list' turns the margin stack into a sheet. 390-full.jpg: tiles 2-up, walls stacked, no overflow at 320/390 (render.json).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every word; dist has skip link, focus-visible, forced-colors, labelled output counters, aria-expanded on sheet/menu, aria-invalid on fields.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg: sticky stack, reveals done; the signature only moves on tap so a scroller sees no thesis motion; 14 identical data-reveal hooks suggest one reveal style.

wow.notes: 1440-first.jpg: packing-list board + margin stack + wall checker is a real tool in the carton language; empty stack is a black void and the output is a list/total, not a designed saveable carton stack.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg: radius 0 throughout, flute edge consistent, designed footer bundle; dist has SVG favicon, apple-touch, OG, theme-color, JSON-LD, print and forced-colors CSS, no transition: all.

elevate.move: Bring 3-4 approved frames into the carton system as 'what's inside the box': each inside a flute-edged carton frame with a stencil plate, duotoned to ink/lemon so they read as one shoot, revealed by the carton flap (chamfer clip-path) opening on scroll; one beside the wall checker, one behind the haul-away bundle, one in reviews.

Put the city into the display type and let the margin stack show its output at 0 ms: a clearable sample carton already stacked so the plate reads PC 01 with a range, replacing the empty black void, and end the hero ~80px earlier so the paper band peeks.
